lobby.error.not_host: Only the host can do that.
lobby.error.wrong_phase: That can only be changed in the lobby.

lobby.error.not_ready: Everyone has to be ready before the host can start.
lobby.error.debug_off: Debug commands are off on this server.
lobby.error.map_unavailable: That map is not available on this server yet.

game.minimap: Minimap: your van, your target, items on the floor and forklifts
game.spectateHint: Click or press A for the next player. You join at the next round.

hud.quota.stolen: Stolen box: run it to the office!
hud.box.title: Your order box!

hud.feed.runover: {name} got run over by a forklift and dropped {item}

hud.heat: Too hot! Get off the oven floor
hud.ko.title: KO!
round.intro.title: Get ready
round.results.title: Round {round} results
round.results.race.timeUp: Time’s up: nobody delivered, ranked by items controlled
round.podium.title: Session podium
round.podium.tieBreak: Tied on points: item points decide
round.podium.tieNote: ★ Tied on points: the item count decided the place
round.podium.next: Back to the lobby in {seconds} s
item.orderBox.desc: Packed and ready. Carry it to the office across the street.
menu.title: Menu

menu.leaveText: Leave room {code}? The session goes on without you and your points are not kept.
menu.leaveTextOffline: Go back to the title screen?
howto.heading: How to play
howto.goal.heading: Raid the {store}: grab your target, bank it at your van
howto.goal.find: Find your target. It glows on the map and an arrow at the screen edge points to it.
howto.goal.pickUp: Pick it up when you stand next to it.
howto.goal.bank: Carry it to your van. It banks itself within {tiles} tiles.
howto.goal.again: A point for you, and a new target appears. Repeat!
howto.goal.joke: Odd joke items sparkle. Bank one for {points} points.
howto.goal.session: Every round gives placement points ({points}, …). The most points after the last round wins the podium.
howto.mode.timed: {minutes} minutes on the clock. Most points banked when it runs out wins.
howto.mode.race: Bank {quota} items, then run the order box to the office. First delivery wins. Drop it and anyone can steal it!
howto.mode.teams: Red against blue. A team shares one van, one quota and one order box. No friendly fire.
howto.controls.heading: Play with a keyboard and mouse or a gamepad
howto.controls.note: The button hints in a round follow whatever you touched last.
howto.fight.heading: Everything is a weapon
howto.fight.roll: Every item you pick up hands you a random weapon.
howto.fight.attack: Swing, throw or spray at whoever is in your way.
howto.fight.block: Hold to block with the pan. It even bounces throws back.
howto.fight.wear: Weapons wear out after a few uses, then it is back to your fists.
howto.fight.ko: Lose all your health and you are knocked out.
howto.fight.drops: Whatever you carried drops on the floor for anyone to grab.
howto.fight.respawn: You are back at your van {seconds} s later.
howto.staff.heading: Mind the staff
howto.staff.stockerText: Wanders the aisles and parks stock carts. Hit one and it hits back.
howto.staff.guardText: Patrols the store and chases anyone Wanted.
howto.staff.butcherText: Keeps behind the meat counter. Come too close and he swings.
howto.staff.forkliftText: Beeps and never stops. A hit knocks you down and drops what you carry.
howto.wanted.heading: Wanted
howto.wanted.hitWorker: Hit a worker or a shopper.
howto.wanted.seen: A guard sees you hit another player.
howto.wanted.lasts: Wanted lasts {seconds} s after your last offence.
howto.wanted.chase: Every guard comes after you, inside and out.
howto.store2.heading: What is different at {store}
howto.store2.gatesText: The only ways out. One way, outwards. Crossing stops you {stop} s ({carry} s when carrying).
howto.store2.ovenText: The floor in front of it burns. One item always waits right on the hot spot.
howto.store2.customersText: Shoppers get in the way and panic when a fight starts. Hitting one makes you Wanted.
howto.store2.cartsText: Walk into a cart to push it, hit it to shove it. Great for blocking a lane.
howto.store2.lot: At {store} the vans park outside in the lot, and the office is across the road.
